plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF risk. Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Trim CRWD to 10% and SMH to 5% to reduce sector concentration. Buy ALB at 10% to add a top-quality name and diversify the portfolio.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a realistic ~1.5%/month outlook. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but still carries market exposure.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure. Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Buy ALB at 4% to add a quality name and diversify. Add to CRWD to 16% to increase exposure to a strong performer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan prioritizes risk-first growth, aiming for a realistic ~2.5%/month outlook. It maintains some market exposure and selective leverage for growth, with moderate drawdown potential.

plan: Add to SOXL to 6% and SPAL to 6% to increase exposure to leveraged ETFs. Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet mandate. Buy ALB at 6% to add a high-scoring setup. Add to CRWD to 16% and SMH to 15% to increase exposure to strong performers and sectors.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for a realistic ~4%/month outlook. It significantly increases both upside and drawdown potential due to higher leverage and concentration. Be aware of leveraged ETF decay and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.
